dedupe_keys.name: department of public works and engineering road datasets

description: Department of Public Works and Engineering: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Public Works and Engineering. Coverage: Department of Public Works and Engineering. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Devam Eden Duvar, Üstgeçit, Köprü Güçlendirme ve Heyelan Önleme Çalışm; Tamamlanan Duvar, Üstgeçit, Köprü Güçlendirme ve Heyelan Önleme Çalışm; Planlanan Duvar, Üstgeçit, Köprü Güçlendirme ve Heyelan Önleme Çalışma. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
